public_profile.coverage_note: The €5 billion figure is a fund target, not a final close or current assets-under-management figure; the European Commission disclosed a €1 billion contribution. EQT manages the fund. Mistral’s €3 billion Series D and EUCLYD’s €200 million-plus Series A are company-wide round totals, not the fund’s disclosed individual checks. For Mistral, the company’s primary announcement identifies Samsung Electronics as lead and Scaleup Europe Fund as a co-lead.
public_profile.summary: Scaleup Europe Fund is a European growth and late-stage technology fund managed by EQT and backed by the European Commission and institutional investors. It targets €5 billion and focuses on strategic technologies from Series B through pre-IPO. In September 2026, the fund co-led Mistral AI’s €3 billion Series D, with Samsung Electronics leading, and co-led EUCLYD’s €200 million-plus Series A. Neither company disclosed the fund’s individual commitment.

facts.label: Fund manager
facts.value: EQT manages the Scaleup Europe Fund after being selected by the European Innovation Council Fund Board.

facts.label: Target fund size
facts.value: The fund targets €5 billion. This is a target, not a confirmed final close or current assets under management.

facts.label: European Commission contribution
facts.value: The European Commission disclosed a €1 billion contribution to the fund.

facts.label: Investment stage and size
facts.value: Growth and late-stage investments, generally from Series B through pre-IPO; EIC materials describe investments of €100 million and above, including follow-ons.

facts.label: Strategic technology focus
facts.value: AI, quantum technologies, robotics, clean energy, space, biotechnology, advanced industrial systems and related strategic technology areas.

facts.label: Founding investors named by EQT
facts.value: European Commission, Novo Holdings, Allianz, APG, EIFO, CriteriaCaixa, Santander/Mouro Capital, Fondazione Compagnia San Paolo, Intesa Sanpaolo and Fondazione Cariplo.

facts.label: Investment governance
facts.value: EQT describes the fund manager as market-based and independent; investment decisions are made by EQT on commercial and merit-based grounds.

milestones.description: Mistral AI announced a €3 billion Series D with Samsung Electronics leading and Scaleup Europe Fund among the co-leads; the fund’s individual commitment was not disclosed.
The fund and EQT as its manager were publicly presented at the European Innovation Council Summit.
EUCLYD announced a €200 million-plus Series A co-led by Scaleup Europe Fund, which it identified as managed by EQT.

track_record.description: EUCLYD Series A (September 2026): the company announced more than €200 million in total financing, co-led by Samsung, Somerset Capital Partners, Scaleup Europe Fund and Innovation Industries. The fund’s individual contribution was not disclosed.

Euclyd’s primary announcement independently identifies Scaleup Europe Fund as an EQT-managed co-lead in the same company-wide round; the disclosed total is not the fund’s individual investment amount.

Mistral AI Series D (September 2026): the company announced a €3 billion round with Samsung Electronics leading and Scaleup Europe Fund as a co-lead. The €3 billion is the company-wide round total; the fund’s individual commitment was not disclosed.

IT之家 coverage of Mistral AI’s September 2026 Series D reports the €3 billion company-wide round; Mistral’s primary announcement clarifies the lead/co-lead roles. The fund’s individual commitment was not disclosed.
TechCrunch coverage independently identifies Scaleup Europe Fund as a co-lead in Mistral AI’s €3 billion company-wide Series D; the fund’s individual commitment was not disclosed.

sources.quote: Scaleup Europe Fund is targeting €5bn to support Europe’s most promising technology companies from Series B through to pre-IPO. Investments will focus on strategic sectors including AI applications, deep AI, quantum, robotics, clean energy, space, biotech, advanced industrial systems and beyond.
Founded by the European Commission, alongside Novo Holdings, Allianz, APG, EIFO, CriteriaCaixa, Santander/Mouro Capital, Fondazione Compagnia San Paolo, Intesa Sanpaolo and Fondazione Cariplo.

public_profile.summary.text: Scaleup Europe Fund 是由 EQT 管理、并获 European Commission 和机构投资者支持的欧洲成长及后期科技基金。其目标规模为 50 亿欧元，专注于从 Series B 到 pre-IPO 阶段的战略技术。2026 年 9 月，该基金与 Samsung Electronics 领投、联合领投了 Mistral AI 的 30 亿欧元 Series D，并联合领投了 EUCLYD 的 2 亿欧元以上 Series A。两家公司均未披露该基金的单独出资额。

public_profile.track_record[1].descripti.text: Euclyd的主要公告独立确认Scaleup Europe Fund为同一公司轮次中由EQT管理的联合领投方；披露的总额并非该基金的单独投资金额。
